statement.zh-TW: 能把一家小店帳上的項目分成資產、負債與股東權益，並說出每一類代表什麼
statement.en: Classify the items in a small shop's books as assets, liabilities or equity, and say what each class represents

text.zh-TW: 以為只有現金才算資產，存貨與設備不算
text.en: Thinking that only cash counts as an asset, not inventory or equipment

text.zh-TW: 把向銀行借來的錢當成公司自己的錢（股東權益）
text.en: Treating money borrowed from the bank as the company's own money (equity)

text.zh-TW: 把股東出的資金當成公司欠股東的債
text.en: Treating the owners' capital as a debt the company owes them

statement.zh-TW: 能用會計恆等式（資產＝負債＋股東權益）判斷一筆交易之後哪些項目變動、帳是否仍然平衡
statement.en: Use the accounting equation (assets = liabilities + equity) to work out which items change after a transaction and whether the books still balance

text.zh-TW: 以為花錢買東西之後資產總計一定變少
text.en: Thinking that total assets must fall whenever cash is spent

text.zh-TW: 以為借到錢之後股東權益變多
text.en: Thinking that borrowing money increases equity

text.zh-TW: 以為一筆交易只會動到一個項目
text.en: Thinking that a transaction changes only one item

text.zh-TW: 把股東權益總額當成這一期賺到的錢
text.en: Treating total equity as the profit earned this period

text.zh-TW: 把資產總計當成帳上的現金
text.en: Treating total assets as the cash on hand

statement.zh-TW: 能說明報表上的每個數字都來自交易紀錄，並從數字倒推公司做過哪一類交易
statement.en: Explain that every figure on the statements comes from recorded transactions, and infer from a figure what kind of transaction the company must have made

text.zh-TW: 以為先有報表，再把交易填進去
text.en: Thinking that the statements come first and transactions are filled in afterwards

text.zh-TW: 看到帳上現金變多就以為公司一定有賺錢
text.en: Assuming the company must have made a profit because cash went up

text.zh-TW: 以為報表上的數字查不出來源
text.en: Thinking that figures on the statements cannot be traced back to anything

statement.zh-TW: 能像一個會追問的讀者，說出讀一張報表時該問的問題
statement.en: Read a statement like a reader who keeps asking questions, and say what to ask when reading one

text.zh-TW: 以為報表上的數字一定正確、不必追問
text.en: Assuming the figures on a statement must be right and need no questioning

text.zh-TW: 只看本期淨利，不看錢從哪裡來
text.en: Looking only at profit and not at where the money came from
